description: Minimal read foundation, deferred mount/write contracts and bounded storage reuse
decisions: Core crates are independent of mount libraries.
Write batches describe ordering and durability, not universal crash atomicity.
Real fixture and OS qualification remain required beyond the initial contract seed.

verification.scope: Historical original bootstrap receipt only; not rerun for planning revisions 0.2 or 0.3.

dependency_semantics: Phase edges require accepted common-interface evidence plus any matching target/profile evidence. Aggregate phase status is not a substitute for scoped acceptance; a qualified host lane may proceed while other host lanes remain pending.
